raw_translation: Wannan ya bi bayanin dokar ZXQPH0000QXZ×ZXQPH0001QXZ na kungiyar wasannin kwamfutoci ta duniya: ɓaɓɓuka goma sha biyu a kowace gefe, ƙididdiga na daidaitattun layuka, haɗe-haɗe na diagonal don haɗi, wucewa idan ba za'a iya motsa ba, da kuma rarrabuwa kan matsayi na uku da aka sake. Nau'in da aka wallafa ya bambanta kan haɗe-haɗe na lokaci guda; zaɓi dokar da kake so. Masu adawa da kwamfutoci suna amfani da wani ƙaramin heuristic na cikin gida kuma ba shi da wani injin gasar.
source: This follows the International Computer Games Association’s 8×8 rule description: twelve pieces per side, exact full-line counts, diagonal adjacency for connection, passing when unable to move, and a draw on a third repeated position. A published variant differs on simultaneous connections; select the rule you prefer. The computer opponent uses a small local heuristic and is not a tournament engine.
